units.zh: 段榮 子韶
units.en: Duan Rong; Duan Shao
units.literal: Duan Rong; Duan Shao

units.zh: 段榮，字子茂，姑臧武威人也。
units.en: Duan Rong, styled Zimao, was a native of Guzang in Wuwei.
units.literal: Duan Rong, styled Zimao, was a native of Guzang in Wuwei.

units.zh: 祖信，仕沮渠氏，後入魏，以豪族徙北邊，仍家於五原郡。
units.en: His grandfather Xin served the Juqu clan; later he entered Wei and, as a prominent clan, was relocated to the northern frontier, settling in Wuyuan Commandery.
units.literal: His grandfather Xin served the Juqu clan; later he entered Wei and, as a prominent clan, was relocated to the northern frontier, settling in Wuyuan Commandery.

units.zh: 父連，安北府司馬。
units.en: His father Lian served as military aide of the Anbei headquarters.
units.literal: His father Lian served as military aide of the Anbei headquarters.

units.zh: 榮少好曆術，專意星象。
units.en: From youth Duan Rong loved calendrical arts and devoted himself to stars and portents.
units.literal: From youth Rong loved calendrical arts and devoted himself to stars and portents.

units.zh: 正光初，語人曰：「《易》云 『觀於天文以察時變』，又曰『天垂象，見吉兇』，今觀玄象，察人事，不及十年，當有亂矣。」
units.en: At the beginning of Zhenguang, he told people, "The Book of Changes says, 'Observe the heavens to discern changes in the times,' and also says, 'Heaven displays signs, revealing fortune and calamity.' Now observing the dark heavens and examining human affairs, within ten years there will be turmoil."
units.literal: At the beginning of Zhenguang, he told people, "The Book of Changes says, 'Observe the heavens to discern changes in the times,' and also says, 'Heaven displays signs, revealing fortune and calamity.' Now observing the dark heavens and examining human affairs, within ten years there will be turmoil."

units.zh: 或問曰：「起於何處，當可避乎？」
units.en: Someone asked, "Where will it begin — can one avoid it?"
units.literal: Someone asked, "Where will it begin — can one avoid it?"

units.zh: 榮曰：「構亂之源，此地為始，恐天下因此橫流，無所避也。」
units.en: Duan Rong said, "The source of strife will begin here; I fear the realm will be swept along in the torrent — there is nowhere to escape."
units.literal: Rong said, "The source of strife will begin here; I fear the realm will be swept along in the torrent — there is nowhere to escape."

units.zh: 未幾，果如言。
units.en: Before long, it happened just as he said.
units.literal: Before long, it happened just as he said.

units.zh: 榮遇亂，與鄉舊攜妻子，南趣平城。
units.en: When turmoil came, Duan Rong, with his fellow townsmen, took wife and children and hurried south toward Pingcheng.
units.literal: When turmoil came, Rong, with his fellow townsmen, took wife and children and hurried south toward Pingcheng.

units.zh: 屬杜洛周為亂，榮與高祖謀誅之，事不捷，共奔尒朱榮。
units.en: Just then Du Luozhou rebelled; Duan Rong and Gao Huan plotted to kill him, but the matter failed, and together they fled to Erzhu Rong.
units.literal: Just then Du Luozhou rebelled; Rong and the Grand Ancestor plotted to kill him, but the matter failed, and together they fled to Erzhu Rong.

units.zh: 後高祖建義山東，榮贊成大策。
units.en: Later, when Gao Huan raised the righteous banner in Shandong, Duan Rong helped bring the great plan to fruition.
units.literal: Later, when the Grand Ancestor raised the righteous banner in Shandong, Rong helped bring the great plan to fruition.

units.zh: 為行臺右丞，西北道慰喻大使，巡方曉喻，所在下之。
units.en: He served as right deputy of the mobile office, ambassador to pacify and instruct the northwest circuit, touring the regions to enlighten and persuade; wherever he went, people submitted.
units.literal: He served as right deputy of the mobile office, ambassador to pacify and instruct the northwest circuit, touring the regions to enlighten and persuade; wherever he went, people submitted.

units.zh: 高祖南討鄴，留榮鎮信都，仍授鎮北將軍，定州刺史。
units.en: When Gao Huan marched south to attack Ye, he left Duan Rong to garrison Xindu and concurrently appointed him general who pacifies the north and governor of Ding Province.
units.literal: When the Grand Ancestor marched south to attack Ye, he left Rong to garrison Xindu and concurrently appointed him General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Ding Province.

units.zh: 時攻鄴未克，所須軍資，榮轉輸無闕。
units.en: At that time the attack on Ye had not yet succeeded; whatever military supplies were needed, Duan Rong transported them without shortfall.
units.literal: At that time the attack on Ye had not yet succeeded; whatever military supplies were needed, Rong transported them without shortfall.

units.zh: 高祖入洛，論功封姑臧縣侯，邑八百戶。
units.en: When Gao Huan entered Luoyang, for merit Duan Rong was enfeoffed marquis of Guzang County with a fief of eight hundred households.
units.literal: When the Grand Ancestor entered Luoyang, for merit he was enfeoffed Marquis of Guzang County with a fief of eight hundred households.

units.zh: 轉授瀛州刺史。
units.en: He was transferred to governor of Ying Province.
units.literal: He was transferred to Governor of Ying Province.

units.zh: 榮妻，皇后姊也，榮恐高祖招私親之議，固推諸將，竟不之州。
units.en: Duan Rong's wife was the empress's elder sister; fearing Gao Huan would draw criticism for favoring private kin, Duan Rong firmly yielded to other generals and in the end never went to the province.
units.literal: Rong's wife was the empress's elder sister; fearing the Grand Ancestor would draw criticism for favoring private kin, Rong firmly yielded to other generals and in the end never went to the province.

units.zh: 尋行相州事，後為濟州刺史。
units.en: Soon he acted as administrator of Xiang Province; later he became governor of Ji Province.
units.literal: Soon he acted as administrator of Xiang Province; later he became Governor of Ji Province.

units.zh: 天平三年，轉行泰州事。
units.en: In the third year of Tianping, he was transferred to act as administrator of Tai Province.
units.literal: In the third year of Tianping, he was transferred to act as administrator of Tai Province.

units.zh: 榮性溫和，所歷皆推仁恕，民吏愛之。
units.en: Duan Rong was mild by nature; everywhere he served he practiced benevolence and forbearance, and officials and common people alike loved him.
units.literal: Rong was mild by nature; everywhere he served he practiced benevolence and forbearance, and officials and common people alike loved him.

units.zh: 初，高祖將圖關右，與榮密謀，榮盛稱未可。
units.en: At first, when Gao Huan planned to take the Guanxi region, he secretly consulted Duan Rong, who strongly argued it was not yet feasible.
units.literal: At first, when the Grand Ancestor planned to take the Guanxi region, he secretly consulted Rong, who strongly argued it was not yet feasible.

units.zh: 及渭曲失利，高祖悔之，曰：「吾不用段榮之言，以至於此。」
units.en: When they suffered defeat at Weiqu, Gao Huan regretted it and said, "I did not heed Duan Rong's counsel, and so came to this."
units.literal: When they suffered defeat at Weiqu, the Grand Ancestor regretted it and said, "I did not heed Duan Rong's counsel, and so came to this."

units.zh: 四年，除山東大行臺、大都督，甚得物情。
units.en: In the fourth year he was appointed grand commissioner of Shandong and grand commander; he won the hearts of all greatly.
units.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed grand commissioner of Shandong and grand commander; he won the hearts of all greatly.

units.zh: 元象元年，授儀同三司。
units.en: In the first year of Yuanxiang, he was granted Equal to the Three Dukes.
units.literal: In the first year of Yuanxiang, he was granted Equal to the Three Dukes.

units.zh: 二年五月卒，年六十二。
units.en: In the fifth month of the second year he died, aged sixty-two.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the second year he died, aged sixty-two.

units.zh: 贈使持節、定冀滄瀛四州諸軍事、定州刺史、太尉、尚書左僕射，諡曰昭景。
units.en: Posthumously he was granted bearer of the staff of authority, commander-in-chief of military affairs in the four provinces of Ding, Ji, Cang, and Ying, governor of Ding Province, grand commandant, and left vice director of the masters of writing; his posthumous title was Zhaojing.
units.literal: Posthumously he was granted bearer of the staff of authority, commander-in-chief of military affairs in the four provinces of Ding, Ji, Cang, and Ying, Governor of Ding Province, Grand Commandant, and Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; his posthumous title was Zhaojing.

units.zh: 皇建初，配饗高祖廟庭。
units.en: At the beginning of Huangjian, he was given associated sacrifice in Gao Huan's temple court.
units.literal: At the beginning of Huangjian, he was given associated sacrifice in the Grand Ancestor's temple court.

units.zh: 二年，重贈大司馬、尚書令、武威王。
units.en: In the second year he was again posthumously granted grand marshal, director of the masters of writing, and prince of Wuwei.
units.literal: In the second year he was again posthumously granted Grand Marshal, Director of the Masters of Writing, and Prince of Wuwei.

units.zh: 長子韶嗣。
units.en: His eldest son Shao succeeded.
units.literal: His eldest son Shao succeeded.

units.zh: 韶，字孝先，小名鐵伐。
units.en: Shao, styled Xiaoxian, had the childhood name Tiefa.
units.literal: Shao, styled Xiaoxian, had the childhood name Tiefa.

units.zh: 少工騎射，有將領才略。
units.en: From youth he was skilled at mounted archery and possessed the talent and strategy of a commander.
units.literal: From youth he was skilled at mounted archery and possessed the talent and strategy of a commander.

units.zh: 高祖以武明皇后姊子，盡器愛之，常置左右，以為心腹。
units.en: Gao Huan, because Shao was the nephew of Empress Lou Wuming, fully treasured and loved him, kept him constantly at his side, and regarded him as a trusted confidant.
units.literal: The Grand Ancestor, because he was the nephew of Empress Lou Wuming, fully treasured and loved him, kept him constantly at his side, and regarded him as a trusted confidant.

units.zh: 建義初，領親信都督。
units.en: At the beginning of the righteous enterprise, he commanded trusted bodyguards.
units.literal: At the beginning of the righteous enterprise, he commanded trusted bodyguards.

units.zh: 中興元年，從高祖拒尒朱兆，戰於廣阿。
units.en: In the first year of Zhongxing, he followed Gao Huan in resisting Erzhu Zhao; they fought at Guang'a.
units.literal: In the first year of Zhongxing, he followed the Grand Ancestor in resisting Erzhu Zhao; they fought at Guang'a.

units.zh: 高祖謂韶曰：「彼衆我寡，其若之何？」
units.en: Gao Huan said to Shao, "They are many and we are few — what is to be done?"
units.literal: The Grand Ancestor said to Shao, "They are many and we are few — what is to be done?"

units.zh: 韶曰：「所謂衆者，得衆人之死；
units.en: Shao said, "What is called 'many' is winning the people's willingness to die;
units.literal: Shao said, "What is called 'many' is winning the people's willingness to die;

units.zh: 強者，得天下之心。
units.en: what is called 'strong' is winning the hearts of the realm.
units.literal: what is called 'strong' is winning the hearts of the realm.

units.zh: 尒朱狂狡，行路所見，裂冠毀冕，拔本塞源，邙山之會，搢紳何罪，兼殺主立君，不脫旬朔，天下思亂，十室而九。
units.en: Erzhu is reckless and cunning — what everyone on the road sees: they tear off caps and destroy crowns, uproot foundations and block the source. At the assembly at Mount Mang, what crime did the gentry commit? Yet they also killed their lord and set up another — within no more than ten days and a month the realm yearns for disorder; nine of ten households.
units.literal: Erzhu is reckless and cunning — what everyone on the road sees: they tear off caps and destroy crowns, uproot foundations and block the source. At the assembly at Mount Mang, what crime did the gentry commit? Yet they also killed their lord and set up another — within no more than ten days and a month the realm yearns for disorder; nine of ten households.

units.zh: 王躬昭德義，除君側之惡，何往而不克哉！」
units.en: Your Highness personally displays virtue and righteousness, removing evil at the ruler's side — where could you go without prevailing!"
units.literal: Your Highness personally displays virtue and righteousness, removing evil at the ruler's side — where could you go without prevailing!"

units.zh: 高祖曰：「吾雖以順討逆，奉辭伐罪，但弱小在強大之間，恐無天命，卿不聞之也？」
units.en: Gao Huan said, "Although I take righteousness against rebellion and go forth with a mandate to punish crime, we are weak amid the strong — I fear we lack Heaven's mandate. Have you not heard of this?"
units.literal: The Grand Ancestor said, "Although I take righteousness against rebellion and go forth with a mandate to punish crime, we are weak amid the strong — I fear we lack Heaven's mandate. Have you not heard of this?"

units.zh: 答曰：「韶聞小能敵大，小道大淫，皇天無親，唯德是輔，尒朱外賊天下，內失善人，知者不為謀，勇者不為鬭，不肖失職，賢者取之，復何疑也。」
units.en: He answered, "Shao has heard that the small can overcome the large, and the way that is small may yet overcome one that is great and excessive; August Heaven is not partial — only virtue receives its aid. Erzhu outwardly harms the realm and inwardly loses good men; the wise will not plan for him, the brave will not fight for him. The unworthy lose their offices; the worthy take them — what doubt remains?"
units.literal: He answered, "Shao has heard that the small can overcome the large, and the way that is small may yet overcome one that is great and excessive; August Heaven is not partial — only virtue receives its aid. Erzhu outwardly harms the realm and inwardly loses good men; the wise will not plan for him, the brave will not fight for him. The unworthy lose their offices; the worthy take them — what doubt remains?"

units.zh: 遂與兆戰，兆軍潰。
units.en: They then fought Zhao; Zhao's army collapsed.
units.literal: They then fought Zhao; Zhao's army collapsed.

units.zh: 攻劉誕於鄴。
units.en: They attacked Liu Dan at Ye.
units.literal: They attacked Liu Dan at Ye.

units.zh: 及韓陵之戰，韶督率所部，先鋒陷陣。
units.en: At the Battle of Hanling, Shao commanded and led his division as vanguard, breaking through the enemy lines.
units.literal: At the Battle of Hanling, Shao commanded and led his division as vanguard, breaking through the enemy lines.

units.zh: 尋從高祖出晉陽，追尒朱兆於赤谼嶺，平之。
units.en: Soon he followed Gao Huan out of Jinyang, pursued Erzhu Zhao to Chihong Ridge, and pacified him.
units.literal: Soon he followed the Grand Ancestor out of Jinyang, pursued Erzhu Zhao to Chihong Ridge, and pacified him.

units.zh: 以軍功封下洛縣男。
units.en: For military merit he was enfeoffed baron of Xialuo County.
units.literal: For military merit he was enfeoffed Baron of Xialuo County.

units.zh: 又從襲取夏州，擒斛律彌娥突，加龍驤將軍、諫議大夫，累遷武衛將軍。
units.en: He also followed in the surprise capture of Xia Province, taking Hulu Mi'etuo prisoner; he was promoted to dragon-courser general and remonstrating grandee, rising in succession to general of martial guards.
units.literal: He also followed in the surprise capture of Xia Province, taking Hulu Mi'etuo prisoner; he was promoted to Dragon-Courser General and Remonstrating Grandee, rising in succession to General of Martial Guards.

units.zh: 後恩賜父榮姑臧縣侯，其下洛縣男啟讓繼母弟寧安。
units.en: Later, by grace his father Duan Rong was given the title marquis of Guzang County; Shao petitioned to yield his barony of Xialuo County to his younger half-brother Ning'an.
units.literal: Later, by grace his father Rong was given the title Marquis of Guzang County; Shao petitioned to yield his barony of Xialuo County to his younger half-brother Ning'an.

units.zh: 興和四年，從高祖禦周文帝於邙山。
units.en: In the fourth year of Xinghe, he followed Gao Huan in opposing Yuwen Tai at Mount Mang.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Xinghe, he followed the Grand Ancestor in opposing the Zhou Emperor Wen at Mount Mang.

units.zh: 高祖身在行間，為西魏將賀拔勝所識，率銳來逼。
units.en: Gao Huan was personally among the ranks; recognized by the Western Wei general Heba Sheng, Sheng led crack troops to press close.
units.literal: The Grand Ancestor was personally among the ranks; recognized by the Western Wei general Heba Sheng, Sheng led crack troops to press close.

units.zh: 韶從傍馳馬引弓反射，一箭斃其前驅，追騎懾憚，莫敢前者。
units.en: Shao galloped up from the side, drew his bow and shot back; one arrow killed Sheng's lead rider. The pursuers were awed and dared not press forward.
units.literal: Shao galloped up from the side, drew his bow and shot back; one arrow killed Sheng's lead rider. The pursuers were awed and dared not press forward.

units.zh: 西軍退，賜馬並金，進爵為公。
units.en: When the Western army withdrew, he was granted horses and gold and his rank was advanced to duke.
units.literal: When the Western army withdrew, he was granted horses and gold and his rank was advanced to duke.

units.zh: 武定四年，從征玉壁。
units.en: In the fourth year of Wuding, he followed the campaign against Yubi.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Wuding, he followed the campaign against Yubi.

units.zh: 時高祖不豫，攻城未下，召集諸將，共論進止之宜。
units.en: At that time Gao Huan was unwell; the siege had not succeeded, and he summoned the generals to discuss together whether to advance or halt.
units.literal: At that time the Grand Ancestor was unwell; the siege had not succeeded, and he summoned the generals to discuss together whether to advance or halt.

units.zh: 謂大司馬斛律金、司徒韓軌、左衛將軍劉豐等曰：「吾每與段孝先論兵，殊有英略，若使比來用其謀，亦可無今日之勞矣。
units.en: He said to grand marshal Hulu Jin, minister of education Han Gui, left guard general Liu Feng, and others, "Whenever I discuss warfare with Duan Xiaoxian, he shows remarkable strategic brilliance. Had I used his plans all along, I might have been spared today's toil.
units.literal: He said to Grand Marshal Hulu Jin, Minister of Education Han Gui, Left Guard General Liu Feng, and others, "Whenever I discuss warfare with Duan Xiaoxian, he shows remarkable strategic brilliance. Had I used his plans all along, I might have been spared today's toil.

units.zh: 吾患勢危篤，恐或不虞，欲委孝先以鄴下之事，何如？」
units.en: I fear my illness is grave and dread some unforeseen turn; I wish to entrust Xiaoxian with affairs below Ye — what do you think?"
units.literal: I fear my illness is grave and dread some unforeseen turn; I wish to entrust Xiaoxian with affairs below Ye — what do you think?"

units.zh: 金等曰：「知臣莫若君，實無出孝先。」
units.en: Jin and the others said, "No one knows a subject better than the lord — truly none surpasses Xiaoxian."
units.literal: Jin and the others said, "No one knows a subject better than the lord — truly none surpasses Xiaoxian."

units.zh: 仍謂韶曰：「吾昔與卿父冒涉險艱，同獎王室，建此大功。
units.en: He then said to Shao, "Long ago your father and I braved danger and hardship together, jointly upheld the royal house, and built this great achievement.
units.literal: He then said to Shao, "Long ago your father and I braved danger and hardship together, jointly upheld the royal house, and built this great achievement.

units.zh: 今病疾如此，殆將不濟，宜善相翼佐，克茲負荷。」
units.en: Now my illness is such that I may not recover; you should well assist each other and bear up under this burden."
units.literal: Now my illness is such that I may not recover; you should well assist each other and bear up under this burden."

units.zh: 即令韶從顯祖鎮鄴，召世宗赴軍。
units.en: He thereupon ordered Shao to follow Gao Yang in garrisoning Ye and summoned Gao Cheng to the army.
units.literal: He thereupon ordered Shao to follow the Founding Emperor in garrisoning Ye and summoned the Heir Apparent to the army.

units.zh: 高祖疾甚，顧命世宗曰：「段孝先忠亮仁厚，智勇兼備，親戚之中，唯有此子，軍旅大事，宜共籌之。」
units.en: When Gao Huan's illness grew severe, he entrusted Gao Cheng, saying, "Duan Xiaoxian is loyal, upright, benevolent, and generous, combining wisdom and courage. Among kinsmen, only this man — on great military matters, you should plan together."
units.literal: When the Grand Ancestor's illness grew severe, he entrusted the Heir Apparent, saying, "Duan Xiaoxian is loyal, upright, benevolent, and generous, combining wisdom and courage. Among kinsmen, only this man — on great military matters, you should plan together."

units.zh: 五年春，高祖崩於晉陽，秘不發喪。
units.en: In the spring of the fifth year Gao Huan died at Jinyang; the death was kept secret and mourning was not announced.
units.literal: In the spring of the fifth year the Grand Ancestor died at Jinyang; the death was kept secret and mourning was not announced.

units.zh: 俄而侯景構亂，世宗還鄴，韶留守晉陽。
units.en: Before long Hou Jing provoked rebellion; Gao Cheng returned to Ye and Shao remained to hold Jinyang.
units.literal: Before long Hou Jing provoked rebellion; the Heir Apparent returned to Ye and Shao remained to hold Jinyang.

units.zh: 世宗還，賜女樂十數人，金十斤，繒帛稱是，封長樂郡公。
units.en: When Gao Cheng returned, he granted more than ten female musicians, ten jin of gold, and silk and brocade in corresponding measure, and enfeoffed Shao as duke of Changle Commandery.
units.literal: When the Heir Apparent returned, he granted more than ten female musicians, ten jin of gold, and silk and brocade in corresponding measure, and enfeoffed Shao as Duke of Changle Commandery.

units.zh: 世宗征潁川，韶留鎮晉陽。
units.en: Gao Cheng campaigned against Yingchuan; Shao remained to garrison Jinyang.
units.literal: The Heir Apparent campaigned against Yingchuan; Shao remained to garrison Jinyang.

units.zh: 別封真定縣男，行幷州刺史。
units.en: Separately he was enfeoffed baron of Zhending County and acted as governor of Bing Province.
units.literal: Separately he was enfeoffed Baron of Zhending County and acted as Governor of Bing Province.

units.zh: 顯祖受禪，別封朝陵縣，又封霸城縣，加位特進。
units.en: When Gao Yang received the abdication, Shao was separately enfeoffed in Chaoling County, again enfeoffed in Bacheng County, and granted special advancement.
units.literal: When the Founding Emperor received the abdication, Shao was separately enfeoffed in Chaoling County, again enfeoffed in Bacheng County, and granted special advancement.

units.zh: 啟求歸朝陵公，乞封繼母梁氏為郡君。
units.en: He petitioned to return the dignity of duke of Chaoling and begged that his stepmother Lady Liang be enfeoffed as commandery lady.
units.literal: He petitioned to return the dignity of Duke of Chaoling and begged that his stepmother Lady Liang be enfeoffed as commandery lady.

units.zh: 顯祖嘉之，別以梁氏為安定郡君。
units.en: Gao Yang approved; separately Lady Liang was made lady of Anding Commandery.
units.literal: The Founding Emperor approved; separately Lady Liang was made Lady of Anding Commandery.

units.zh: 又以霸城縣侯讓其繼母弟孝言。
units.en: He also yielded the marquisate of Bacheng County to his younger half-brother Xiaoyan.
units.literal: He also yielded the marquisate of Bacheng County to his younger half-brother Xiaoyan.

units.zh: 論者美之。
units.en: Commentators praised him.
units.literal: Commentators praised him.

units.zh: 天保三年，為冀州刺史、六州大都督，有惠政，得吏民之心。
units.en: In the third year of Tianbao, he served as governor of Ji Province and grand commander of six provinces; his benevolent administration won the hearts of officials and people.
units.literal: In the third year of Tianbao, he served as Governor of Ji Province and grand commander of six provinces; his benevolent administration won the hearts of officials and people.

units.zh: 四年十二月，梁將東方白額潛至宿預，招誘邊民，殺害長吏，淮、泗擾動。
units.en: In the twelfth month of the fourth year, the Liang general Dongfang Baie secretly reached Suyu, recruited and enticed frontier people, killed local officials, and stirred turmoil along the Huai and Si rivers.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of the fourth year, the Liang general Dongfang Baie secretly reached Suyu, recruited and enticed frontier people, killed local officials, and stirred turmoil along the Huai and Si rivers.

units.zh: 五年二月，詔徵韶討之。
units.en: In the second month of the fifth year an edict summoned Shao to suppress them.
units.literal: In the second month of the fifth year an edict summoned Shao to suppress them.

units.zh: 既至，會梁將嚴超達等軍逼涇州；
units.en: When he arrived, the Liang generals Yan Chaoda and others were pressing Jing Province;
units.literal: When he arrived, the Liang generals Yan Chaoda and others were pressing Jing Province;

units.zh: 又陳武帝率衆將攻廣陵，刺史王敬寶遣使告急；
units.en: Chen Baxian was also leading a host of generals to attack Guangling; governor Wang Jingbao sent envoys in urgent appeal;
units.literal: Chen Baxian was also leading a host of generals to attack Guangling; Governor Wang Jingbao sent envoys in urgent appeal;

units.zh: 復有尹思令率衆萬餘人，謀襲盱貽。
units.en: Yin Siling too led more than ten thousand men, plotting a surprise attack on Xuyi.
units.literal: Yin Siling too led more than ten thousand men, plotting a surprise attack on Xuyi.

units.zh: 三軍咸懼。
units.en: The whole army was afraid.
units.literal: The whole army was afraid.

units.zh: 韶謂諸將曰：「自梁氏喪亂，國無定主，人懷去就，強者從之。
units.en: Shao said to the generals, "Since the Liang house fell into disorder, the state has had no fixed ruler; people weigh where to go and where to stay, following whichever side seems stronger.
units.literal: Shao said to the generals, "Since the Liang house fell into disorder, the state has had no fixed ruler; people weigh where to go and where to stay, following whichever side seems stronger.

units.zh: 霸先等智小謀大，政令未一，外託同德，內有離心，諸君不足憂，吾揣之熟悉矣。」
units.en: Chen Baxian and the like have small minds and large ambitions; their orders are not unified — outwardly claiming unity, inwardly divided at heart. You need not worry, gentlemen; I know them thoroughly."
units.literal: Baxian and the like have small minds and large ambitions; their orders are not unified — outwardly claiming unity, inwardly divided at heart. You need not worry, gentlemen; I know them thoroughly."

units.zh: 乃留儀同敬顯儁、堯難宗等圍守宿預，自將步騎數千人倍道赴涇州。
units.en: He left Equal-to-the-Three-Dukes Jing Xianjun, Yao Nazong, and others to besiege and hold Suyu; he himself led several thousand infantry and cavalry by forced march toward Jing Province.
units.literal: He left Equal-to-the-Three-Dukes Jing Xianjun, Yao Nazong, and others to besiege and hold Suyu; he himself led several thousand infantry and cavalry by forced march toward Jing Province.

units.zh: 途出盱眙，思令不虞大軍卒至，望旗奔北。
units.en: Passing through Xuyi, Yin Siling did not expect the main army to arrive so suddenly; at sight of the banners he fled north.
units.literal: Passing through Xuyi, Yin Siling did not expect the main army to arrive so suddenly; at sight of the banners he fled north.

units.zh: 進與超達合戰，大破之，盡獲其舟艦器械。
units.en: Advancing, he joined battle with Chaoda and routed them utterly, capturing all their boats and equipment.
units.literal: Advancing, he joined battle with Chaoda and routed them utterly, capturing all their boats and equipment.

units.zh: 謂諸將士曰：「吳人輕躁，本無大謀，今破超達，霸先必走。」
units.en: He told the officers and soldiers, "The Wu people are rash by nature and never had great plans. Now that Chaoda is broken, Chen Baxian will surely flee."
units.literal: He told the officers and soldiers, "The Wu people are rash by nature and never had great plans. Now that Chaoda is broken, Baxian will surely flee."

units.zh: 即回赴廣陵。
units.en: He at once turned back toward Guangling.
units.literal: He at once turned back toward Guangling.

units.zh: 陳武帝果遁去。
units.en: Chen Baxian indeed fled.
units.literal: Chen Baxian indeed fled.

units.zh: 追至楊子柵，望揚州城乃還，大獲其軍資器物，旋師宿預。
units.en: Pursuing as far as Yangzi stockade, he sighted Yangzhou city and turned back; he captured a great store of military supplies and equipment, then wheeled his army back to Suyu.
units.literal: Pursuing as far as Yangzi stockade, he sighted Yangzhou city and turned back; he captured a great store of military supplies and equipment, then wheeled his army back to Suyu.

units.zh: 六月，韶遣辯士喻白額禍福，白額於是開門請盟。
units.en: In the sixth month, Shao sent eloquent envoys to explain fortune and disaster to Baie; Baie thereupon opened the gates and requested an alliance.
units.literal: In the sixth month, Shao sent eloquent envoys to explain fortune and disaster to Baie; Baie thereupon opened the gates and requested an alliance.

units.zh: 韶與行臺辛術等議，且為受盟。
units.en: Shao discussed with the mobile commissioner Xin Shu and others and provisionally accepted the alliance.
units.literal: Shao discussed with the mobile commissioner Xin Shu and others and provisionally accepted the alliance.

units.zh: 盟訖，度白額終不為用，因執而斬之，並其諸弟等並傳首京師。
units.en: When the alliance was concluded, judging that Baie would never be useful, he seized and executed him, and together with his brothers sent their heads to the capital.
units.literal: When the alliance was concluded, judging that Baie would never be useful, he seized and executed him, and together with his brothers sent their heads to the capital.

units.zh: 江淮帖然，民皆安輯。
units.en: The Huai and Yangzi regions grew calm; the people were all settled.
units.literal: The Huai and Yangzi regions grew calm; the people were all settled.

units.zh: 顯祖嘉其功，詔賞吳口七十人，封平原郡王。
units.en: Gao Yang applauded his merit; an edict granted seventy Wu captives and enfeoffed him as prince of Pingyuan Commandery.
units.literal: The Founding Emperor applauded his merit; an edict granted seventy Wu captives and enfeoffed him as Prince of Pingyuan Commandery.

units.zh: 清河王岳之克郢州，執司徒陸法和，韶亦豫行，築層城，於新蔡立郭默戍而還。
units.en: When Prince Qinghe Yue captured Ying Province and took minister of education Lu Fazhe prisoner, Shao also took part in the expedition, built tiered fortifications, established the Guo Mo garrison at Xincai, and returned.
units.literal: When Prince Qinghe Yue captured Ying Province and took Minister of Education Lu Fazhe prisoner, Shao also took part in the expedition, built tiered fortifications, established the Guo Mo garrison at Xincai, and returned.

units.zh: 皇建元年，領太子太師。
units.en: In the first year of Huangjian, he served as grand preceptor of the crown prince.
units.literal: In the first year of Huangjian, he served as Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince.

units.zh: 大寧二年，除幷州刺史。
units.en: In the second year of Daining, he was appointed governor of Bing Province.
units.literal: In the second year of Daining, he was appointed Governor of Bing Province.

units.zh: 高歸彥作亂冀州，詔與東安王婁叡率衆討平之，遷太傅，賜女樂十人，並歸彥果園一千畝。
units.en: When Gao Guiyan rebelled in Ji Province, an edict ordered Shao and Prince Dong'an Lou Rui to lead troops to suppress and pacify him; Shao was transferred to grand preceptor, granted ten female musicians, and also given Guiyan's orchard of a thousand mu.
units.literal: When Gao Guiyan rebelled in Ji Province, an edict ordered Shao and Prince Dong'an Lou Rui to lead troops to suppress and pacify him; Shao was transferred to Grand Preceptor, granted ten female musicians, and also given Guiyan's orchard of a thousand mu.

units.zh: 仍蒞幷州，為政舉大綱，不存小察，甚得民和。
units.en: He still went to Bing Province; in governing he upheld broad principles and did not dwell on petty scrutiny, winning great harmony among the people.
units.literal: He still went to Bing Province; in governing he upheld broad principles and did not dwell on petty scrutiny, winning great harmony among the people.

units.zh: 十二月，周武帝遣將率羌夷與突厥合衆逼晉陽，世祖自鄴倍道兼行赴救。
units.en: In the twelfth month, Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou dispatched generals leading Qiang and tribal forces together with the Turks in a combined host pressing Jinyang; Emperor Wucheng hurried from Ye by forced march to the rescue.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, the Zhou Emperor Wu dispatched generals leading Qiang and tribal forces together with the Turks in a combined host pressing Jinyang; the Shizu Emperor hurried from Ye by forced march to the rescue.

units.zh: 突厥從北結陣而前，東距汾河，西被風谷。
units.en: The Turks advanced from the north in battle formation, touching the Fen River on the east and Wind Valley on the west.
units.literal: The Turks advanced from the north in battle formation, touching the Fen River on the east and Wind Valley on the west.

units.zh: 時事既倉卒，兵馬未整，世祖見如此，亦欲避之而東。
units.en: Events had come in a rush; troops and horses were not yet in order. Seeing the field, Emperor Wucheng wished to withdraw eastward.
units.literal: Events were sudden; troops and horses were not yet arrayed. Seeing this, the Shizu Emperor also wished to withdraw eastward.

units.zh: 尋納河間王孝琬之請，令趙郡王盡護諸將。
units.en: Soon he accepted Prince of Hejian Xiaowan's plea and put Prince of Zhao Commandery in overall charge of the generals.
units.literal: Soon he accepted Prince of Hejian Xiaowan's request and ordered Prince of Zhao Commandery to take overall command of the generals.

units.zh: 時大雪之後，周人以步卒為前鋒，從西山而下，去城二里。
units.en: After heavy snow, the Zhou made infantry their vanguard, descending from the western hills two li from the city.
units.literal: After heavy snow, the Zhou men made infantry their vanguard, descending from the western hills — two li from the city.

units.zh: 諸將咸欲逆擊之。
units.en: Every general wanted to meet them with a counterattack.
units.literal: All the generals wished to meet them with a counterattack.

units.zh: 詔曰：「步人氣勢自有限，今積雪既厚，逆戰非便，不如陣以待之。
units.en: An edict ran, "Infantry can only push so far. With snow this deep, a meeting fight is ill advised — hold your lines and wait.
units.literal: An edict said, "Infantry by nature have limited momentum. With the snow so deep, a meeting engagement is ill advised — better to hold formation and wait.

units.zh: 彼勞我逸，破之必矣。」
units.en: They will be weary and we rested — the victory is certain."
units.literal: They will be weary and we rested — defeating them is certain."

units.zh: 既而交戰，大破之，敵前鋒盡殪，無復孑遺，自餘通宵奔遁。
units.en: Battle was joined and the enemy was routed. The vanguard was annihilated to the last man; the rest fled through the night.
units.literal: Battle was joined and the enemy was routed. The vanguard was annihilated to the last man; the rest fled through the night.

units.zh: 仍令韶率騎追之，出塞不及而還。
units.en: Shao was ordered to lead cavalry in pursuit — he could not overtake them before the frontier and turned back.
units.literal: Shao was then ordered to lead cavalry in pursuit; he could not overtake them before the frontier and returned.

units.zh: 世祖嘉其功，別封懷州武德郡公，進位太師。
units.en: Emperor Wucheng commended his merit, separately enfeoffed him duke of Wude Commandery in Huai Province, and advanced him to grand preceptor.
units.literal: The Shizu Emperor commended his merit, separately enfeoffed him Duke of Wude Commandery in Huai Province, and advanced him to Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 周冢宰宇文護母閻氏先配中山宮，護聞閻尚存，乃因邊境移書，請還其母，並通鄰好。
units.en: The mother of Zhou chancellor Yuwen Hu, Lady Yan, had first been assigned to Zhongshan Palace. Learning she still lived, Hu sent a letter through the border asking for her return and proposing neighborly peace.
units.literal: The mother of Zhou chancellor Yuwen Hu, Lady Yan, had first been assigned to Zhongshan Palace. Learning that Yan still lived, Hu sent a letter through the border asking for his mother's return and proposing neighborly peace.

units.zh: 時突厥屢犯邊，韶軍於塞下。
units.en: At that time the Turks repeatedly raided the frontier; Shao encamped below the passes.
units.literal: At that time the Turks repeatedly raided the frontier; Shao encamped below the passes.

units.zh: 世祖遣黃門徐世榮乘傳賫周書問韶。
units.en: Emperor Wucheng sent Attendant of the Yellow Gate Xu Shirong by fast relay with the Zhou letter to consult Shao.
units.literal: The Shizu Emperor sent Attendant of the Yellow Gate Xu Shirong by fast relay with the Zhou letter to consult Shao.

units.zh: 韶以周人反覆，本無信義，比晉陽之役，其事可知。
units.en: Shao said the Zhou were fickle and had never kept faith — the affair at Jinyang had already shown as much.
units.literal: Shao said the Zhou were fickle and had never kept faith; the affair at Jinyang had already shown as much.

units.zh: 護外托為相，其實王也，既為母請和，不遣一介之使申其情理，乃據移書即送其母，恐示之弱。
units.en: Hu outwardly styled himself chancellor but was in truth a king. He asked peace for his mother's sake, yet sent not a single envoy to state his case — and we would return her on the strength of a letter alone. That would look like weakness.
units.literal: Hu outwardly styled himself chancellor but was in truth a king. Having asked peace for his mother's sake, he sent not a single envoy to state his case — yet we would return her on the strength of a letter alone. That would look like weakness.

units.zh: 如臣管見，且外許之，待後放之未晚。
units.en: In my humble view, we should agree outwardly and release her later — that would not be too late.
units.literal: In my humble view, we should agree outwardly and release her later — that would not be too late.

units.zh: 不聽。
units.en: He was not heeded.
units.literal: He was not heeded.

units.zh: 遂遣使以禮將送。
units.en: An envoy was sent to escort her back with full ceremony.
units.literal: An envoy was then sent to escort her back with full ceremony.

units.zh: 護既得母，仍遣將尉遲迥等襲洛陽。
units.en: Once Hu had his mother, he still sent generals Yuchi Jiong and others to strike at Luoyang.
units.literal: Once Hu had his mother, he still sent generals Yuchi Jiong and others to strike at Luoyang.

units.zh: 詔遣蘭陵王長恭、大將軍斛律光率衆擊之，軍於邙山之下，逗留未進。
units.en: An edict dispatched Prince of Lanling Gao Chang Gong and Grand General Hulü Guang with troops to attack them. They encamped below Mount Mang and lingered without advancing.
units.literal: An edict dispatched Prince of Lanling Chang Gong and Grand General Hulü Guang with troops to attack them; they encamped below Mount Mang and lingered without advancing.

units.zh: 世祖召謂曰：「今欲遣王赴洛陽之圍，但突厥在此，復須鎮禦，王謂如何？」
units.en: Emperor Wucheng summoned Shao and said, "I wish to send you to the siege at Luoyang — but the Turks are here and must still be held in check. What do you think?"
units.literal: The Shizu Emperor summoned Shao and said, "I wish to send you to the siege at Luoyang — but the Turks are here and must still be held in check. What do you think?"

units.zh: 韶曰：「北虜侵邊，事等疥癬，今西羌窺逼，便是膏肓之病，請奉詔南行。」
units.en: Shao said, "Northern raiders on the frontier are scabies; the Western Qiang pressing in are a disease in the vitals. I beg leave to go south as ordered."
units.literal: Shao said, "Northern barbarians on the frontier are a matter of scabies; the Western Qiang pressing in are a disease in the vitals. I beg leave to go south as ordered."

units.zh: 世祖曰：「朕意亦爾。」
units.en: Emperor Wucheng said, "My mind is the same."
units.literal: The Shizu Emperor said, "My mind is the same."

units.zh: 乃令韶督精騎一千，發自晉陽。
units.en: He ordered Shao to command a thousand elite cavalry and set out from Jinyang.
units.literal: He then ordered Shao to command a thousand elite cavalry, setting out from Jinyang.

units.zh: 五日便濟河，與大將共量進止。
units.en: In five days he had crossed the river and joined the grand generals in weighing advance and halt.
units.literal: In five days he had crossed the river and joined the grand generals in deliberating advance and halt.

units.zh: 韶旦將帳下二百騎與諸軍共登邙阪，聊觀周軍形勢。
units.en: At dawn Shao led two hundred cavalry from his personal retinue and climbed the Mang slopes with the other armies to take a brief look at the Zhou disposition.
units.literal: At dawn Shao led two hundred cavalry from his personal retinue and climbed the Mang slopes with the other armies to take a brief look at the Zhou disposition.

units.zh: 至大和谷，便值周軍，即遣馳告諸營，追集兵馬。
units.en: At Dahe Valley they ran straight into the Zhou army; he at once sent riders racing to the camps to muster troops and horses.
units.literal: At Dahe Valley they ran straight into the Zhou army; he at once sent riders racing to the camps to muster troops and horses.

units.zh: 仍與諸將結陣以待之。
units.en: He then formed battle lines with the generals and waited.
units.literal: He then formed battle lines with the generals and waited.

units.zh: 韶為左軍，蘭陵王為中軍，斛律光為右軍，與周人相對。
units.en: Shao took the left wing, Prince of Lanling the center, and Hulü Guang the right — facing the Zhou.
units.literal: Shao took the left wing, Prince of Lanling the center, and Hulü Guang the right — facing the Zhou.

units.zh: 韶遙謂周人曰：「汝宇文護幸得其母，不能懷恩報德，今日之來，竟何意也？」
units.en: Shao shouted across to the Zhou, "You, Yuwen Hu — you have just recovered your mother and cannot repay kindness with gratitude. What do you mean by coming today?"
units.literal: Shao shouted across to the Zhou, "You, Yuwen Hu — you have just recovered your mother and cannot repay kindness with gratitude. What do you mean by coming today?"

units.zh: 周人曰：「天遣我來，有何可問。」
units.en: The Zhou answered, "Heaven sent us — what is there to ask?"
units.literal: The Zhou answered, "Heaven sent us — what is there to ask?"

units.zh: 韶曰：「天道賞善罰惡，當遣汝送死來耳。」
units.en: Shao said, "Heaven rewards the good and punishes the evil — it has sent you here to die."
units.literal: Shao said, "Heaven rewards the good and punishes the evil — it has sent you here to die."

units.zh: 周軍仍以步人在前，上山逆戰。
units.en: The Zhou army again put infantry in front and came up the hill to fight.
units.literal: The Zhou army again put infantry in front and came up the hill to fight.

units.zh: 韶以彼徒我騎，且却且引，待其力弊，乃遣下馬擊之。
units.en: Shao, seeing foot soldiers against his cavalry, withdrew step by step and drew them on until their strength failed — then ordered his men to dismount and strike.
units.literal: Shao, seeing their foot soldiers against his cavalry, withdrew step by step and drew them on until their strength failed — then ordered his men to dismount and strike.

units.zh: 短兵始交，周人大潰。
units.en: Close combat had barely begun when the Zhou broke completely.
units.literal: Close combat had barely begun when the Zhou broke completely.

units.zh: 其中軍所當者，亦一時瓦解，投墜溪谷而死者甚衆。
units.en: Those who met the center wing collapsed at once as well; very many fell into ravines and gullies and died.
units.literal: Those who met the center wing collapsed at once as well; very many fell into ravines and gullies and died.

units.zh: 洛城之圍，亦即奔遁，盡棄營幕，從邙山至榖水三十里中，軍資器物彌滿川澤。
units.en: The siege of Luoyang also broke and fled, abandoning all camps and tents. From Mount Mang to Gushui for thirty li, military stores and equipment filled the streams and marshes.
units.literal: The siege of Luoyang also broke and fled, abandoning all camps and tents; from Mount Mang to Gushui for thirty li, military stores and equipment filled the streams and marshes.

units.zh: 車駕幸洛陽，親勞將士，於河陰置酒高會，策勳命賞，除太宰，封靈武縣公。
units.en: The imperial carriage visited Luoyang and personally encouraged the soldiers. At Heyin a great feast of wine was set out; merits were assessed and rewards given — Shao was made grand steward and enfeoffed duke of Lingwu County.
units.literal: The imperial carriage visited Luoyang and personally encouraged the soldiers; at Heyin a great feast of wine was set out, merits were assessed and rewards given — Shao was made Grand Steward and enfeoffed Duke of Lingwu County.

units.zh: 天統三年，除左丞相，永昌郡公，食滄州幹。
units.en: In the third year of Tiantong he was made left chancellor, duke of Yongchang Commandery, with revenue from Cang Province.
units.literal: In the third year of Tiantong he was made Left Chancellor, Duke of Yongchang Commandery, with revenue from Cang Province.

units.zh: 武平二年正月，出晉州道，到定隴，築威敵、平寇二城而還。
units.en: In the first month of the second year of Wuping he marched out by the Jinzhou route, reached Dinglong, built the two fortresses Weidi and Pingkou, and returned.
units.literal: In the first month of the second year of Wuping he marched out by the Jinzhou route, reached Dinglong, built the two fortresses Weidi and Pingkou, and returned.

units.zh: 二月，周師來寇，遣韶與右丞相斛律光、太尉蘭陵王長恭同往捍禦。
units.en: In the second month Zhou troops came raiding; Shao was sent with Right Chancellor Hulü Guang and Grand Commandant Prince of Lanling Gao Chang Gong to repel them.
units.literal: In the second month Zhou troops came raiding; Shao was sent with Right Chancellor Hulü Guang and Grand Commandant Prince of Lanling Chang Gong to repel them.

units.zh: 以三月暮行達西境。
units.en: At the end of the third month they marched and reached the western frontier.
units.literal: At the end of the third month they marched and reached the western frontier.

units.zh: 有栢谷城者，乃敵之絕險，石城千仞，諸將莫肯攻圍。
units.en: There was a fortress called Baigu — an enemy stronghold of absolute peril, a stone citadel a thousand ren high — and none of the generals would agree to besiege it.
units.literal: There was a fortress called Baigu — an enemy stronghold of absolute peril, a stone citadel a thousand ren high; none of the generals would agree to besiege it.

units.zh: 韶曰：「汾北、河東，勢為國家之有，若不去栢谷，事同痼疾。
units.en: Shao said, "North of the Fen and east of the Yellow River are lands the state must hold. If Baigu is not taken, the matter is like a chronic disease.
units.literal: Shao said, "North of the Fen and east of the Yellow River are lands the state must hold. If Baigu is not taken, the matter is like a chronic disease.

units.zh: 計彼援兵，會在南道，今斷其要路，救不能來。
units.en: I reckon their relief will come by the southern road; if we cut that vital route, rescue cannot arrive.
units.literal: I reckon their relief will come by the southern road; if we cut that vital route, rescue cannot arrive.

units.zh: 且城勢雖高，其中甚狹，火弩射之，一旦可盡。」
units.en: And though the fortress stands high, within it is very narrow — fire-arrows shot into it could destroy it in a day."
units.literal: And though the fortress stands high, within it is very narrow — fire-arrows shot into it could destroy it in a day."

units.zh: 諸將稱善，遂鳴鼓而攻之。
units.en: The generals approved; drums were sounded and the attack began.
units.literal: The generals approved; drums were sounded and the attack began.

units.zh: 城潰，獲儀同薛敬禮，大斬獲首虜，仍城華谷，置戍而還。
units.en: The fortress fell; Yitong Xue Jingli was captured; heads and captives were taken in great numbers. They then walled Huagu, garrisoned it, and returned.
units.literal: The fortress fell; Yitong Xue Jingli was captured; heads and captives were taken in great numbers; they then walled Huagu, garrisoned it, and returned.

units.zh: 封廣平郡公。
units.en: He was enfeoffed duke of Guangping Commandery.
units.literal: He was enfeoffed Duke of Guangping Commandery.

units.zh: 是月，周又遣將寇邊。
units.en: That month Zhou again sent generals to raid the frontier.
units.literal: That month Zhou again sent generals to raid the frontier.

units.zh: 右丞相斛律光先率師出討，韶亦請行。
units.en: Right Chancellor Hulü Guang led troops out first to attack; Shao also asked to go.
units.literal: Right Chancellor Hulü Guang led troops out first to attack; Shao also asked to go.

units.zh: 五月，攻服秦城。
units.en: In the fifth month they captured and subdued Qincheng.
units.literal: In the fifth month they captured and subdued Qincheng.

units.zh: 周人於姚襄城南更起城鎮，東接定陽，又作深塹，斷絕行道。
units.en: The Zhou south of Yaoxiang raised a new walled town, linking east to Dingyang, and dug a deep trench to cut the road.
units.literal: The Zhou at the south of Yaoxiang raised a new walled town, linking east to Dingyang, and dug a deep trench to cut the road.

units.zh: 韶乃密抽壯士，從北襲之。
units.en: Shao then secretly selected strong men and struck from the north.
units.literal: Shao then secretly selected strong men and struck from the north.

units.zh: 又遣人潛渡河，告姚襄城中，令內外相應。
units.en: He also sent men to cross the river in secret and notify those inside Yaoxiang to coordinate inside and out.
units.literal: He also sent men to cross the river in secret and notify those inside Yaoxiang to coordinate inside and out.

units.zh: 渡者千有餘人，周人始覺。
units.en: More than a thousand crossed — only then did the Zhou realize.
units.literal: More than a thousand crossed; only then did the Zhou realize.

units.zh: 於是合戰，大破之，獲其儀同若干顯寶等。
units.en: Battle was joined and the enemy was routed; Yitong Ruogan Xianbao and others were captured.
units.literal: Battle was joined and the enemy was routed; Yitong Ruogan Xianbao and others were captured.

units.zh: 諸將咸欲攻其新城，韶曰：「此城一面阻河，三面地險，不可攻，就令得之，一城地耳。
units.en: The generals all wished to attack the new fortress; Shao said, "That fortress has the river on one side and perilous ground on three — it cannot be taken. Even if we took it, it would be only one town.
units.literal: The generals all wished to attack the new fortress; Shao said, "That fortress has the river on one side and perilous ground on three — it cannot be taken. Even if we took it, it would be only one town.

units.zh: 不如更作一城壅其路，破服秦，並力以圖定陽，計之長者。」
units.en: Better to build another fortress to block their route, break Qincheng, and join forces against Dingyang — that is the longer plan."
units.literal: Better to build another fortress to block their route, break Qincheng, and join forces against Dingyang — that is the longer plan."

units.zh: 將士咸以為然。
units.en: Officers and soldiers all agreed.
units.literal: Officers and soldiers all agreed.

units.zh: 六月，徙圍定陽，其城主開府儀同楊範固守不下。
units.en: In the sixth month they shifted the siege to Dingyang; the fortress commander, Kaifu Yitong Yang Fan, held firm and would not yield.
units.literal: In the sixth month they shifted the siege to Dingyang; the fortress commander, Kaifu Yitong Yang Fan, held firm and would not yield.

units.zh: 韶登山望城勢，乃縱兵急攻之。
units.en: Shao climbed a height to survey the fortress and then unleashed troops in a fierce assault.
units.literal: Shao climbed a height to survey the fortress and then unleashed troops in a fierce assault.

units.zh: 七月，屠其外城，大斬獲首級。
units.en: In the seventh month the outer city was taken and heads and captives were heaped up.
units.literal: In the seventh month the outer city was taken and heads and captives were heaped up.

units.zh: 時韶病在軍中，以子城未克，謂蘭陵王長恭曰：「此城三面重澗險阻，並無走路，唯恐東南一處耳。
units.en: Shao was then ill in camp; the inner citadel had not yet fallen. He told Prince of Lanling Gao Chang Gong, "This fortress is bound by deep ravines and steep peril on three sides — there is no way out save one point in the southeast.
units.literal: Shao was then ill in camp; the inner citadel had not yet fallen. He told Prince of Lanling Chang Gong, "This fortress is bound by deep ravines and steep peril on three sides — there is no way out save one point in the southeast.

units.zh: 賊若突圍，必從此出，但簡精兵專守，自是成擒。」
units.en: If the enemy breaks out, it will surely be there. Post elite troops to hold that spot alone and capture is assured."
units.literal: If the enemy breaks out, it will surely be there. Post elite troops to hold that spot alone and capture is assured."

units.zh: 長恭乃令壯士千餘人設伏於東南澗口。
units.en: Chang Gong then set more than a thousand strong men in ambush at the southeastern ravine mouth.
units.literal: Chang Gong then set more than a thousand strong men in ambush at the southeastern ravine mouth.

units.zh: 其夜果如所策，賊遂出城，伏兵擊之，大潰，範等面縛，盡獲其衆。
units.en: That night it happened exactly as he had foreseen: the enemy came out of the city, the ambush struck, and they broke completely. Fan and the rest were bound and led away; the whole force was taken.
units.literal: That night it happened exactly as he had foreseen: the enemy came out of the city, the ambush struck, and they broke completely. Fan and the rest were bound and led away; the whole force was taken.

units.zh: 韶疾甚，先軍還。
units.en: Shao became gravely ill and returned ahead of the army.
units.literal: Shao became gravely ill and returned before the army.

units.zh: 以功別封樂陵郡公。
units.en: For his merit he received a separate enfeoffment as Duke of Leling Commandery.
units.literal: For his merit he was separately enfeoffed as Duke of Leling Commandery.

units.zh: 竟以疾薨。
units.en: In the end he died of the illness.
units.literal: In the end he died of the illness.

units.zh: 上舉哀東堂，贈物千段、溫明秘器、轀輬車，軍校之士陳衛送至平恩墓所，發卒起冢。
units.en: The emperor mourned him in the Eastern Hall and bestowed one thousand bolts of goods, an imperial lacquered coffin, and a state funeral carriage. Officers and men of the army formed an honor guard and escorted him to the burial ground at Ping'en, and soldiers were conscripted to raise the tomb mound.
units.literal: The emperor raised mourning in the Eastern Hall and bestowed one thousand bolts of goods, an imperial lacquered coffin, and a state funeral carriage; officers and men of the army arrayed themselves as guards and escorted him to the burial ground at Ping'en, and soldiers were conscripted to raise the tomb mound.

units.zh: 贈假黃鉞、使持節、都督朔幷定趙冀滄齊兗梁洛晉建十二州諸軍事，相國、太尉、錄尚書事、朔州刺史，諡曰忠武。
units.en: Posthumously he was granted the acting yellow battle-axe, bearer of the staff of authority, overall command of military affairs in the twelve provinces of Shuo, Bing, Ding, Zhao, Ji, Cang, Qi, Yan, Liang, Luo, Jin, and Jian, and the titles Chancellor of State, Grand Commandant, Recorder of the Department of State Affairs, and Inspector of Shuo Province. His posthumous name was Zhongwu.
units.literal: He was posthumously granted the acting yellow battle-axe, bearer of the staff of authority, commander-in-chief of military affairs in the twelve provinces of Shuo, Bing, Ding, Zhao, Ji, Cang, Qi, Yan, Liang, Luo, Jin, and Jian, Chancellor of State, Grand Commandant, Recorder of the Department of State Affairs, and Inspector of Shuo Province; his posthumous name was Zhongwu.

units.zh: 韶出總軍旅，入參帷幄，功既居高，重以婚媾，望傾朝野。
units.en: Shao went out to command the armies and came in to counsel at the inner court; his merit stood highest, and with marriage ties besides, his prestige tilted court and realm.
units.literal: Shao went out to command the armies and came in to counsel at the inner court; his merit stood highest, and with marriage ties besides, his prestige tilted court and realm.

units.zh: 長於計略，善於禦衆，得將士之心，臨敵之日，人人爭奮。
units.en: He excelled in stratagem and was skilled at commanding troops; he won the hearts of officers and soldiers, and on the day of battle every man strove to outdo the rest.
units.literal: He excelled in stratagem and was skilled at commanding troops; he won the hearts of officers and soldiers, and on the day of battle every man strove to outdo the rest.

units.zh: 又雅性溫慎，有宰相之風。
units.en: By nature he was gentle and cautious, with the bearing of a chief minister.
units.literal: By nature he was gentle and cautious, with the bearing of a chief minister.

units.zh: 教訓子弟，閨門雍肅，事後母以孝聞，齊世勛貴之家罕有及者。
units.en: He trained his sons and younger brothers; his household was orderly and solemn; he was famed for filial duty toward his stepmother — among the meritorious great houses of Qi, few could match him.
units.literal: He trained his sons and younger brothers; his household was orderly and solemn; he was famed for filial duty toward his stepmother — among the meritorious great houses of Qi, few could match him.

units.zh: 然僻於好色，雖居要重，微服間行。
units.en: Yet he was partial to women; though he held weighty office, he would go about in plain dress.
units.literal: Yet he was partial to women; though he held weighty office, he would go about in plain dress.

units.zh: 有皇甫氏，魏黃門郎元瑀之妻，弟謹謀逆，皇甫氏因沒官。
units.en: There was a Lady Huangfu, wife of Wei Attendant Gentleman Yuan Yu; when Yu's younger brother Jin plotted rebellion, Lady Huangfu was confiscated to the state.
units.literal: There was a Lady Huangfu, wife of Wei Attendant Gentleman Yuan Yu; when Yu's younger brother Jin plotted rebellion, Lady Huangfu was confiscated to the state.

units.zh: 韶美其容質，上啟固請，世宗重違其意，因以賜之。
units.en: Shao admired her beauty and memorialized a firm request; Gao Cheng greatly disliked to refuse him and therefore bestowed her upon him.
units.literal: Shao admired her beauty and memorialized a firm request; Shizong greatly disliked to refuse him and therefore bestowed her upon him.

units.zh: 尤嗇於財，雖親戚故舊略無施與。
units.en: He was especially stingy with wealth; even kin and old friends he scarcely gave anything.
units.literal: He was especially stingy with wealth; even kin and old friends he scarcely gave anything.

units.zh: 其子深尚公主，並省丞郎在家佐事十餘日，事畢辭還，人唯賜一杯酒。
units.en: His son Shen had married a princess and served more than ten days at home as a provincial assistant — when the business was done and he took leave to return, Shao gave him only a cup of wine.
units.literal: His son Shen had married a princess and served more than ten days at home as a provincial assistant — when the business was done and he took leave to return, Shao gave him only a cup of wine.

units.zh: 長子懿嗣。
units.en: His eldest son Yi succeeded him.
units.literal: His eldest son Yi succeeded him.

units.zh: 懿，字德猷，有資儀，頗解音樂，又善騎射。
units.en: Yi, styled Deyou, had fine presence, understood music fairly well, and was also skilled at riding and archery.
units.literal: Yi, styled Deyou, had fine presence, understood music fairly well, and was also skilled at riding and archery.

units.zh: 天保初，尚潁川長公主。
units.en: At the beginning of Tianbao he married the Princess of Yingchuan.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao he married the Princess of Yingchuan.

units.zh: 累遷行臺右僕射，兼殿中尚書，出除兗州刺史。
units.en: He rose in succession to acting right vice director of the branch secretariat, concurrent palace master of writing, and was sent out as governor of Yan Province.
units.literal: He rose in succession to Acting Right Vice Director of the Branch Secretariat, concurrent Palace Master of Writing, and was sent out as Governor of Yan Province.

units.zh: 卒。
units.en: He died.
units.literal: He died.

units.zh: 子寶鼎嗣。
units.en: His son Baoding succeeded him.
units.literal: His son Baoding succeeded him.

units.zh: 尚中山長公主，武平末，儀同三司。
units.en: He married the Princess of Zhongshan; at the end of Wuping he held rank equal to the three excellencies.
units.literal: He married the Princess of Zhongshan; at the end of Wuping he held rank equal to the three excellencies.

units.zh: 隋開皇中，開府儀同三司、驃騎大將軍，大業初，卒於饒州刺史。
units.en: Under Sui in the Kaihuang era he was kaifu yitong sansi and general of fast cavalry; at the beginning of Daye he died as governor of Rao Province.
units.literal: Under Sui in the Kaihuang era he was Kaifu Yitong Sansi and General of Fast Cavalry; at the beginning of Daye he died as Governor of Rao Province.

units.zh: 韶第二子深，字德深。
units.en: Shao's second son Shen, styled Deshen.
units.literal: Shao's second son Shen, styled Deshen.

units.zh: 美容貌，寬謹有父風。
units.en: Handsome in appearance, broad and careful — he had his father's manner.
units.literal: Handsome in appearance, broad and careful — he had his father's manner.

units.zh: 天保中，受父封姑臧縣公。
units.en: In the Tianbao era he received his father's enfeoffment as duke of Guzang County.
units.literal: In the Tianbao era he received his father's enfeoffment as Duke of Guzang County.

units.zh: 大寧初，拜通直散騎侍郎。
units.en: At the beginning of Daning he was made regular attendant of the palace cadet.
units.literal: At the beginning of Daning he was made Regular Attendant of the Palace Cadet.

units.zh: 二年，詔尚永昌公主，未婚，主卒。
units.en: In the second year an edict betrothed him to the Princess of Yongchang; before the marriage the princess died.
units.literal: In the second year an edict betrothed him to the Princess of Yongchang; before the marriage the princess died.

units.zh: 河清三年，又詔尚東安公主。
units.en: In the third year of Heqing he was again betrothed by edict to the Princess of Dong'an.
units.literal: In the third year of Heqing he was again betrothed by edict to the Princess of Dong'an.

units.zh: 以父頻著大勳，累遷侍中、將軍、源州大中正，食趙郡幹。
units.en: Because his father repeatedly achieved great merit, he rose in succession to palace attendant, general, grand rectifier of Yuan Province, with revenue from Zhao Commandery.
units.literal: Because his father repeatedly achieved great merit, he rose in succession to Palace Attendant, General, Grand Rectifier of Yuan Province, with revenue from Zhao Commandery.

units.zh: 韶病篤，詔封深濟北王，以慰其意。
units.en: When Shao fell gravely ill, an edict enfeoffed Shen prince of Jibei to comfort him.
units.literal: When Shao fell gravely ill, an edict enfeoffed Shen Prince of Jibei to comfort him.

units.zh: 武平末，徐州行臺左僕射、徐州刺史。
units.en: At the end of Wuping he was left vice director of the Xuzhou branch secretariat and governor of Xuzhou.
units.literal: At the end of Wuping he was Left Vice Director of the Xuzhou Branch Secretariat and Governor of Xuzhou.

units.zh: 入周，拜大將軍，郡公，坐事死。
units.en: After entering Zhou he was made grand general and duke of a commandery; he was executed for an offense.
units.literal: After entering Zhou he was made Grand General and Duke of a commandery; he was executed for an offense.

units.zh: 韶第三子德舉，武平末，儀同三司。
units.en: Shao's third son Deju, at the end of Wuping, held rank equal to the three excellencies.
units.literal: Shao's third son Deju, at the end of Wuping, held rank equal to the three excellencies.

units.zh: 周建德七年，在鄴城與高元海謀逆，誅。
units.en: In the seventh year of Jiande of Zhou, at Ye he plotted rebellion with Gao Yuanhai and was put to death.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Jiande of Zhou, at Ye he plotted rebellion with Gao Yuanhai and was put to death.

units.zh: 韶第四子德衡，武平末，開府儀同三司，隆化時，濟州刺史。
units.en: Shao's fourth son Deheng, at the end of Wuping, was kaifu yitong sansi; at the time of Longhua he was governor of Ji Province.
units.literal: Shao's fourth son Deheng, at the end of Wuping, was Kaifu Yitong Sansi; at the time of Longhua he was Governor of Ji Province.

units.zh: 入周，授儀同大將軍。
units.en: After entering Zhou he was made yitong grand general.
units.literal: After entering Zhou he was made Yitong Grand General.

units.zh: 韶第七子德堪，武平中，儀同三司。
units.en: Shao's seventh son Dekan, in the Wuping era, held rank equal to the three excellencies.
units.literal: Shao's seventh son Dekan, in the Wuping era, held rank equal to the three excellencies.

units.zh: 隋大業初，汴州刺史，卒於汝南郡守。
units.en: At the beginning of Daye of Sui he was governor of Bian Province and died as administrator of Runan Commandery.
units.literal: At the beginning of Daye of Sui he was Governor of Bian Province and died as Administrator of Runan Commandery.

units.zh: 榮第二子孝言，少警發有風儀。
units.en: Rong's second son Xiaoyan, from youth, was quick-witted and had a graceful bearing.
units.literal: Rong's second son Xiaoyan, from youth, was quick-witted and had a graceful bearing.

units.zh: 魏武定末，起家司徒參軍事。
units.en: At the end of the Wei Wuding era he began his career as an army aide to the Minister over the Masses (Situ).
units.literal: At the end of the Wei Wuding era, he began his career as an army aide to the Minister over the Masses (Situ).

units.zh: 齊受禪，其兄韶以別封霸城縣侯授之。
units.en: When Qi received the mandate, his elder brother Shao transferred to him the separate enfeoffment as marquis of Bacheng County.
units.literal: When Qi received the abdication, his elder brother Shao granted him the separate enfeoffment as Marquis of Bacheng County.

units.zh: 累遷儀同三司、度支尚書、清都尹。
units.en: Through successive promotions he rose to rank equal to the three excellencies, minister of revenue, and magistrate of Qingdu.
units.literal: Through successive promotions he rose to rank equal to the three excellencies, minister of revenue, and magistrate of Qingdu.

units.zh: 孝言本以勳戚緒餘，致位通顯，至此便驕奢放逸，無所畏憚。
units.en: Xiaoyan had risen to eminence on the lingering credit of a martial clan — and once there he turned arrogant and unrestrained, afraid of nothing.
units.literal: Xiaoyan had originally reached high office thanks to the residual prestige of meritorious kin; once there he grew arrogant, prodigal, and utterly without fear.

units.zh: 曾夜行，過其賓客宋孝王家宿，喚坊民防援，不時應赴，遂拷殺之。
units.en: Once on a night journey he passed the house where his guest Song Xiaowang was lodging and called out the ward watchmen; when they did not come at once, he had them beaten to death.
units.literal: Once while traveling at night he passed the house where his guest Song Xiaowang was staying and summoned the ward watchmen; when they did not come at once, he had them beaten to death.

units.zh: 又與諸淫婦密遊，為其夫覺，復恃官勢，拷掠而殞。
units.en: He also kept secret company with adulterous women; when a husband caught him at it, Xiaoyan again leaned on his office and beat the man until he died.
units.literal: He also carried on secret affairs with various adulterous women; when a husband discovered it, Xiaoyan again relied on official power and beat the man until he died.

units.zh: 時苑內須果木，科民間及僧寺備輸，悉分向其私宅種植。
units.en: When the palace gardens needed fruit trees, levies were laid on common households and Buddhist temples to supply them — yet Xiaoyan had the whole levy split off and planted at his private residence.
units.literal: When the imperial gardens needed fruit trees, levies were laid on private households and Buddhist temples to supply them — but Xiaoyan had everything diverted to plant at his private residence.

units.zh: 又殿內及園中須石，差車牛從漳河運載，復分車迴取。
units.en: When the palace halls and gardens needed stone, cart oxen were sent to haul it from the Zhang River — and again he diverted the carts on the return trip for his own use.
units.literal: When the palace halls and gardens needed stone, cart oxen were dispatched to haul it from the Zhang River — yet he diverted the carts to carry loads for himself on the return.

units.zh: 事悉聞徹，出為海州刺史。
units.en: When every detail reached the throne, he was sent out as governor of Haizhou.
units.literal: When all these matters became fully known, he was sent out as governor of Haizhou.

units.zh: 尋以其兄故，徵拜都官尚書，食陽城郡幹，仍加開府。
units.en: Soon, on account of his elder brother, he was recalled and made minister of justice, drawing income from Yangcheng Commandery, with an opening establishment added.
units.literal: Soon, because of his elder brother, he was recalled and appointed minister of justice, with income from Yangcheng Commandery, and additionally granted an opening establishment.

units.zh: 遷太常卿，除齊州刺史，以贓賄為御史所劾。
units.en: He was transferred to grand minister of ceremonies, then appointed governor of Qi Province — and impeached by the censorate for bribery and embezzlement.
units.literal: He was transferred to grand minister of ceremonies, then made governor of Qi Province, and was impeached by the censorate for bribery and embezzlement.

units.zh: 屬世祖崩，遇赦免。
units.en: It happened that Emperor Wucheng died; he was pardoned in the general amnesty.
units.literal: It happened that Shizu died; he received amnesty and was pardoned.

units.zh: 拜太常卿，轉食河南郡幹，遷吏部尚書。
units.en: He was made grand minister of ceremonies, transferred to income from Henan Commandery, and promoted to minister of personnel.
units.literal: He was appointed grand minister of ceremonies, transferred to income from Henan Commandery, and promoted to minister of personnel.

units.zh: 祖珽執政，將廢趙彥深，引孝言為助。
units.en: When Zu Ting took power and plotted to remove Zhao Yanshen, he enlisted Xiaoyan as an ally.
units.literal: When Zu Ting held power and planned to remove Zhao Yanshen, he brought Xiaoyan in as an ally.

units.zh: 除兼侍中，入內省，典機密，尋即正，仍吏部尚書。
units.en: Xiaoyan was made acting attendant-in-ordinary, entered the inner secretariat to handle confidential affairs, was soon confirmed in the post, and still held minister of personnel.
units.literal: Xiaoyan was appointed acting attendant-in-ordinary, entered the inner secretariat to manage confidential affairs, was soon made full attendant-in-ordinary, and still held the post of minister of personnel.

units.zh: 孝言既無深鑒，又待物不平，抽擢之徒，非賄則舊。
units.en: Xiaoyan lacked deep judgment and dealt unfairly with men — those he raised were either bought or old connections.
units.literal: Xiaoyan had no deep discernment and treated men unfairly; those he promoted were either bribed or old connections.

units.zh: 有將作丞崔成，忽於衆中抗言曰：「尚書天下尚書，豈獨段家尚書也！」
units.en: Director of palace construction Cui Cheng suddenly cried out before the assembly: "The minister serves the realm — not the Duan household alone!"
units.literal: The director of palace construction Cui Cheng suddenly spoke up before the assembly: "The minister is minister to the realm — not the Duan family's private minister!"

units.zh: 孝言無辭以答，惟厲色遣下而已。
units.en: Xiaoyan had no answer; he could only darken his face and have Cui sent down.
units.literal: Xiaoyan had no reply; he could only darken his face and have Cui dismissed.

units.zh: 尋除中書監，加特進。
units.en: Soon he was made supervisor of the Secretariat and granted extraordinary promotion.
units.literal: Soon he was made supervisor of the Secretariat and granted extraordinary promotion.

units.zh: 又托韓長鸞，共構祖珽之短。
units.en: He also leaned on Han Changluan to join in fabricating charges against Zu Ting.
units.literal: He also relied on Han Changluan to join in fabricating charges against Zu Ting.

units.zh: 及祖出後，孝言除尚書右僕射，仍掌選舉，恣情用捨，請謁大行。
units.en: After Zu was driven out, Xiaoyan was made right vice director of the Masters of Writing, still controlling appointments — disposing of offices as he pleased while petitions and favors poured in.
units.literal: After Zu was removed, Xiaoyan was appointed vice director of the Masters of Writing on the right, still in charge of appointments; he disposed of offices as he pleased, and requests and petitions flowed in abundance.

units.zh: 勑濬京城北隍，孝言監作，儀同三司崔士順、將作大匠元士將、太府少卿酈孝裕、尚書左民郎中薛叔昭、司州治中崔龍子、清都尹丞李道隆、鄴縣令尉長卿、臨漳令崔象、成安令高子徹等並在孝言部下。
units.en: An edict ordered the dredging of the capital's northern moat, with Xiaoyan supervising the work. Yitong of the third rank Cui Shishun, grand master of palace construction Yuan Shijiang, vice minister of the palace store Li Xiaoyu, left bureau director of the people in the Masters of Writing Xue Shuzhao, provincial aide of Sizhou Cui Longzi, vice magistrate of Qingdu Li Daolong, magistrate of Ye County Wei Changqing, magistrate of Linzhang Cui Xiang, magistrate of Cheng'an Gao Ziche, and others all served under Xiaoyan.
units.literal: An edict ordered the dredging of the northern moat of the capital; Xiaoyan supervised the work. Yitong of the third rank Cui Shishun, grand master of palace construction Yuan Shijiang, vice minister of the palace store Li Xiaoyu, left bureau director of the people in the Masters of Writing Xue Shuzhao, provincial aide of Sizhou Cui Longzi, vice magistrate of Qingdu Li Daolong, magistrate of Ye County Wei Changqing, magistrate of Linzhang Cui Xiang, magistrate of Cheng'an Gao Ziche, and others all served under Xiaoyan.

units.zh: 典作日，別置酒高會，諸人膝行跪伏，稱觴上壽，或自陳屈滯，更請轉官，孝言意色揚揚，以為己任，皆隨事報答，許有另授。
units.en: On days he oversaw the work he set out wine and held a grand feast; the men crawled forward on their knees, raised cups to wish him long life, or pleaded their own grievances and asked for transfer. Xiaoyan's bearing was buoyant — he took it as his proper role — and answered each man as the case required, promising separate appointments.
units.literal: On days when he oversaw the work he set out wine and held a grand feast; the men crawled on knees and prostrated themselves, raised cups to wish him long life, or pleaded their own grievances and asked for transfer to other posts. Xiaoyan's bearing was buoyant — he took it as his proper role — and answered each as the case required, promising separate appointments.

units.zh: 富商大賈多被銓擢，緃令所進用人士，咸是粗險放縱之流。
units.en: Wealthy merchants were often selected and promoted; even those he advanced on recommendation were coarse, reckless, unrestrained men.
units.literal: Wealthy merchants were often selected and promoted; even those he advanced on recommendation were all coarse, reckless, and unrestrained men.

units.zh: 尋遷尚書左僕射，特進、侍中如故。
units.en: Soon he was transferred to left vice director of the Masters of Writing; his extraordinary promotion and attendant-in-ordinary status remained unchanged.
units.literal: Soon he was transferred to left vice director of the Masters of Writing; his extraordinary promotion and attendant-in-ordinary status remained unchanged.

units.zh: 孝言富貴豪侈，尤好女色。
units.en: Xiaoyan was rich, noble, and extravagantly luxurious — and above all fond of women.
units.literal: Xiaoyan was rich, noble, and extravagantly luxurious, and above all fond of women.

units.zh: 後娶婁定遠妾董氏，大耽愛之，為此內外不和，更相糾列，坐爭免官，徙光州。
units.en: Later he took Lou Dingyuan's concubine Dong as his wife and became utterly infatuated with her; inside and outside the household turned sour, accusations flew back and forth, and for the quarrel he was stripped of office and banished to Guang Province.
units.literal: Later he took as wife the concubine Dong of Lou Dingyuan and became utterly infatuated with her; because of this, relations inside and outside the household turned sour, accusations flew back and forth, and for the quarrel he was stripped of office and banished to Guang Province.

units.zh: 隆化敗後，有勑追還。
units.en: After the defeat at Longhua, an edict recalled him.
units.literal: After the defeat at Longhua, an edict recalled him.

units.zh: 孝言雖黷貨無厭，恣情酒色，然舉止風流，招致名士，美景良辰，未嘗虛棄，賦詩奏伎，畢盡歡洽。
units.en: Though Xiaoyan was insatiable in grasping wealth and abandoned himself to wine and women, his bearing was elegant; he gathered famous scholars, and on fine days in fair seasons he never let an hour go idle — composing poetry, summoning performers, draining every cup to the dregs.
units.literal: Though Xiaoyan was insatiable in grasping wealth and abandoned himself to wine and women, his bearing was elegant; he gathered famous scholars, and on fine days in fair seasons he never let an hour go idle — composing poetry, summoning performers, draining every cup to the dregs.

units.zh: 雖草萊之士，粗閑文藝，多引入賓館，與同興賞，其貧躓者亦時有乞遺。
units.en: Even men from the humblest walks of life, if they had some slight skill in letters, he often brought into his guest lodges to share the pleasure; those in poverty and distress he also sometimes gave alms.
units.literal: Even men from the humblest walks of life, if they had some slight skill in letters, he often brought into his guest lodges to share in the pleasure; those in poverty and distress he also sometimes gave alms.

units.zh: 世論復以此多之。
units.en: Public opinion again praised him for this.
units.literal: Public opinion again praised him for this.

units.zh: 齊亡入周，授開府儀同大將軍，後加上開府。
units.en: When Qi fell he entered Zhou and was granted opening-establishment honors equal to the grand general; later he was granted supreme opening establishment.
units.literal: When Qi fell he entered Zhou and was granted opening-establishment honors equal to the grand general; later he was granted supreme opening establishment.

units.zh: 史臣曰：段榮以姻戚之重，遇時來之會，功伐之地，亦足稱焉。
units.en: The historian says: Duan Rong, by weight of marriage kinship, met the tide of the times — in fields where merit is reckoned, he is worth naming.
units.literal: The historian says: Duan Rong, by weight of marriage kinship, met the tide of the times; in fields where merit is reckoned, he is worth naming.

units.zh: 韶光輔七君，克隆門業，每出當閫外，或任以留臺，以猜忌之朝，終其眉壽。
units.en: Shao brightly assisted seven rulers and enlarged the family estate; whenever he went out he held the outer command, or was entrusted with the capital in his absence — and in a court of suspicion he lived out his years to the full.
units.literal: Shao brightly assisted seven rulers and enlarged the family estate; whenever he went out he held the outer command, or was entrusted with the capital in his absence — and in a court of suspicion he lived out his years to the full.

units.zh: 屬亭候多警，為有齊上將，豈其然乎？
units.en: Just when frontier beacons were often alight, that Qi should have such a supreme general — can it have been mere chance?
units.literal: Just when frontier beacons were often alight, that Qi should have such a supreme general — can it have been mere chance?

units.zh: 當以志謝矜功，名不逾實，不以威權御物，不以智數要時，欲求覆餗，其可得也？
units.en: Surely it was because he kept ambition from pride in merit, kept fame from outrunning reality, did not rule men by raw power, and did not seize the moment by cunning stratagem — who, then, could have overturned his bowl?
units.literal: Surely it was because he kept ambition from pride in merit, kept fame from outrunning reality, did not rule men by raw power, and did not seize the moment by cunning stratagem — who, then, could have overturned his bowl?

units.zh: 語曰「率性之謂道」，此其效歟？
units.en: The saying runs, "To follow one's nature is called the Way" — is this not its proof?
units.literal: The saying runs, "To follow one's nature is called the Way" — is this not its proof?

units.zh: 贊曰：榮發其原，韶大其門。
units.en: The encomium says: Rong opened the springhead; Shao enlarged the gate.
units.literal: The encomium says: Rong opened the springhead; Shao enlarged the gate.

units.zh: 位因功顯，望以德尊。
units.en: Rank rose through merit; renown rested on virtue.
units.literal: Rank rose through merit; renown rested on virtue.

s0003.quote: 祖信，仕沮渠氏，後入魏，以豪族徙北邊，仍家於五原郡。

s0011.quote: 屬杜洛周為亂，榮與高祖謀誅之，事不捷，共奔尒朱榮。

s0018.quote: 榮妻，皇后姊也，榮恐高祖招私親之議，固推諸將，竟不之州。

s0033.quote: 高祖以武明皇后姊子，盡器愛之，常置左右，以為心腹。

s0049.quote: 後恩賜父榮姑臧縣侯，其下洛縣男啟讓繼母弟寧安。

s0059.quote: 仍謂韶曰：「吾昔與卿父冒涉險艱，同獎王室，建此大功。

s0238.quote: 史臣曰：段榮以姻戚之重，遇時來之會，功伐之地，亦足稱焉。

s0239.quote: 韶光輔七君，克隆門業，每出當閫外，或任以留臺，以猜忌之朝，終其眉壽。

s0210.quote: 曾夜行，過其賓客宋孝王家宿，喚坊民防援，不時應赴，遂拷殺之。

s0219.quote: 祖珽執政，將廢趙彥深，引孝言為助。

s0222.quote: 有將作丞崔成，忽於衆中抗言曰：「尚書天下尚書，豈獨段家尚書也！」

s0225.quote: 又托韓長鸞，共構祖珽之短。

s0227.quote: 勑濬京城北隍，孝言監作，儀同三司崔士順、將作大匠元士將、太府少卿酈孝裕、尚書左民郎中薛叔昭、司州治中崔龍子、清都尹丞李道隆、鄴縣令尉長卿、臨漳令崔象、成安令高子徹等並在孝言部下。

s0232.quote: 後娶婁定遠妾董氏，大耽愛之，為此內外不和，更相糾列，坐爭免官，徙光州。
